title: Simplicial compatibility of the slice-cone interpolation prism
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, products and internal functor simplicial sets of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and relative joins and right join cones of [def-coef-infinity-relative-join]. Let $X$ be any small simplicial set and $c$ a vertex. Define $L=X_{/c}$ by $L_m=\{\tau:\Delta^{m+1}\to X\mid\tau(m+1)=c\}$, with operators extending $\alpha:[l]\to[m]$ by sending the new last vertex to $m+1$. Put $W=L\star\Delta^0$ and $J=\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,X)\star_X X$, using target evaluation and $1_X$.
For an $n$-simplex $(\epsilon,w)$ of $\Delta^1\times W$, let $\epsilon:[n]\to[1]$ be monotone, and let $r$ be the last base index of the join simplex $w$. If $r\geq0$, its base is represented by $\tau:\Delta^{r+1}\to X$ ending at $c$. Define monotone maps
$$\rho:[1]\times[r]\to[r+1],\qquad \rho(t,j)=\begin{cases}r+1&t=1\text{ and }\epsilon(j)=1,\\
j&\text{otherwise},\end{cases}$$
$$\nu:[n]\to[r+1],\qquad \nu(j)=\begin{cases}j&j\leq r\text{ and }\epsilon(j)=0,\\
r+1&\text{otherwise}.\end{cases}$$
Form the relative-join simplex with cut $r$, initial arrow prism $\tau\rho$, target-coordinate simplex $\tau\nu$, and final $X$-block constant at $c$ (omitted when $r=n$). For $r=-1$, use the pure $X$-simplex constant at $c$. These assignments commute with all faces and degeneracies and define a simplicial map $G:\Delta^1\times W\to J$. They are natural in maps of pointed simplicial sets $(X,c)\to(X',c')$. For every base vertex $e:a\to c$ of $L$, the edge $G(-,e)$ is contained in the arrow factor and is represented by the square with horizontal arrows $1_a,e$, source side $1_a$, and target side $e$. On the cone vertex $G$ is constant at the pure $X$-vertex $c$. No horn-filling or quasicategory hypothesis is required.
